text: Barcelona, 1992. Olympic 400m semi-final. Derek Redmond had trained his whole life for this. On the back straight, *his hamstring tore.* He went down. Then he got up and kept hopping toward the finish. A man pushed past security. *It was his father, Jim.* They had started his career together. They would finish this together. *65,000 people stood up.* Officially: did not finish. Send this to your dad.
title: His Dad Ran Onto the Olympic Track 🏃‍♂️❤️
